data.current_summary: Diagnostic trouble codes joined to the vehicles whose federal record names them
data.current_description: Mined from the summaries of NHTSA manufacturer communications and from owner complaint narratives. A match is only counted where the surrounding text is discussing a diagnostic result, so hyphenated part numbers and document references are not returned as codes. `defined_by` is `standard` (generic OBD-II, and a `meaning` is returned), `manufacturer` (second character 1 or 3 — the automaker owns the meaning and no definition is returned for it) or `undefined`. Counts are mentions in the federal files, never failure rates.

Each result includes the DTC code, definition source (`standard` for OBD-II, `manufacturer` for proprietary codes, or `undefined`), meaning where available, and mention counts from federal records. Counts represent document mentions, not failure rates. Hyphenated part numbers and document references are excluded from results.
